source.note: Search summary: 214 km of slopes; 68 lift and cable-car systems: 1 funicular (Serfaus village railway), 11 gondolas, 16 chairlifts, 8 T-bar/platter lifts and 30 conveyor belts (other = funicular + conveyors), so 66 of 68 are typed. Published hourly capacity 90,000 persons; the 30 conveyor belts are said to add a further 12,000/hour.

Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools and rental shops operate at the bases. The area markets itself strongly to families (children's areas and ski schools)

character: Three villages on a sunny plateau above the upper Inn valley in western Tyrol share one lift network between about 1,200 m and 2,828 m, with mostly easy and intermediate slopes. The area is known for its family and children's facilities and for car-free Serfaus, where a village railway links the car park and the lifts.
learning: Search summary and reference: regarded as one of Austria's leading family ski areas, with extensive children's areas, many conveyor belts and ski schools in each village. Confirm lesson products.
